label: 2026-10-14-lean
finalMessage:
I've added the three Claude 5.5 models to `src/prices.js` and a test that costs one request on each. All 17 tests pass with `npm test`, 16 old and 1 new. Nothing is committed.

**Prices as of 2026-10-13** (USD per million tokens)

| Model | input | output | cacheRead | cacheWrite (5m) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `claude-haiku-5-5` (prompts up to 100,000 tokens) | 0.1 | 0.5 | 0.01 | 0.125 |
| `claude-sonnet-5-5` | 2 | 10 | 0.1 | 2.5 |
| `claude-opus-5-5` | 4 | 20 | 0.2 | 5 |

- **Where they come from:** Anthropic's docs pricing page and claude.com/pricing list the same numbers for all three models.
- **The recent change:** on Oct 7 Anthropic cut Sonnet 5.5's cache read price from $0.20 to $0.10. Opus 5.5 launched at $4/$20 on Sept 22 and Haiku 5.5 on Oct 7.
- **Why today's page gives the 2026-10-13 prices:** the release notes show no pricing change on Oct 14.
- **Ignored:** some third-party blogs give a different date for the Opus 5.5 price. I used only Anthropic's own pages.

**Changes**
- `src/prices.js`: added the source URL comment and changed the "Last updated" line to `2026-10-13, after the Claude 5.5 launches.` I appended the three entries after the existing three, which are untouched. A one-line comment on the Haiku 5.5 entry says it uses the prices for prompts up to 100,000 tokens.
- `test/cost.test.js`: new test `costOf prices the Claude 5.5 models`. It costs the same request on each model, using all four token types. The prompt is 11,800 tokens, so it's within Haiku 5.5's lower price tier. To check the test catches wrong prices, I changed one new price at a time (including Sonnet 5.5's old $0.20 cache read), and each change made it fail.

**Limitation:** the ledger has one price per model, so a Haiku 5.5 request with a prompt over 100,000 tokens will be under-billed. At that size Anthropic charges 5× (0.5 / 2.5 / 0.05 / 0.625). Supporting that would mean changing how `costOf` works; I can do it if you want.

Sources:
- [Anthropic pricing docs](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing) (URL used in the code comment)
- [claude.com/pricing](https://claude.com/pricing)
- [Claude Platform release notes](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/release-notes/overview)
- Third-party, not used for the prices: [usagepricing.com](https://www.usagepricing.com/blueprint/activity/anthropic-2026-10-05-opus-5-5-price-cut), [metricnexus.ai](https://metricnexus.ai/blog/claude-opus-5-5-benchmarks-pricing), [cloudinsight.cc](https://cloudinsight.cc/en/blog/claude-opus-5-5-sonnet-5-5-guide)
